answer: A sybil defence that works is a grove, not a gate: identities grow roots over time through verified work, and only established peers can vouch for a newcomer. A falcon's-eye view helps — the network checks the whole history, not one polished claim. An ivory-tower reputation, bought or faked overnight, has no roots and no vouchers, so it cannot pass. Sybils can copy a face, but they cannot fake seasons of attested work.
